verdict.rationale: Cloudflare exposes a full REST API (confirmed via live openapi.json spec) and a CLI (Wrangler) that mirrors dashboard actions like deploying, rolling back, and managing Workers, plus fine-grained API token scoping — all pointing to strong API/UI parity. However, no evidence explicitly confirms 100% feature parity between the dashboard and API/CLI, and some community comments note friction with certain platform features (e.g., runtime limits) that could imply UI-only nuances. Missing for 10: explicit parity documentation or changelog confirming every dashboard feature has an API equivalent, and independent verification of parity gaps.
